reason: This is not just a logging-only PR: it touches the core stats update/write path plus `ANALYZE` execution (`pkg/executor/analyze*.go`, stats cache, storage save/update, global stats, DDL subscriber, interfaces). Even though the subject mentions slow updates and logging, the file set suggests behavioral changes in how statistics are produced, persisted, and propagated, which can indirectly affect optimizer decisions and system-wide plan quality. The cross-cutting nature and presence of both executor and statistics storage changes make it plausible that high-severity regressions could hide here.
